Alternatively, as we also observed no group difference in striatal 18F-DOPA Kçer, these findings may indicate that the participants selected for our samples did not markedly differ in the overall striatal pathophysiology. In the 54 patients with dopamine measures evaluated across 2 sites, there was no group difference in striatal 18F-DOPA Keer, indicating similar levels of presynaptic dopamine synthesis and storage capacity. This finding

differs from previous smaller studies that have associated increased striatal dopamine function with a good antipsychotic response.20 24 Using the same 18F-DOPA PET method, we reported lower striatal Keer in 12 patients with TRS compared with 12 antipsychotic respondersạẠồIn another study comparing a TRS group currently taking clozapine with antipsychotic-responsive patients, the resistant group again had lower Ker than the responders.? In first-episode psychosis, striatal Ker was positively related to subsequent antipsychotic response.4 Lower
